rules.title: Children's bedroom in North
rules.explanation: Eastern and northern sectors are traditionally associated with learning and activity.
rules.practical_impact: Provides traceable Knowledge coverage for children's bedroom placement.
rules.architectural_note: Choose an East or North room during future reallocation where possible.
rules.existing_home_note: Place the study desk so the child can face East or North and maintain good daylight.
rules.source_note: Belief-based guidance; interpretations and schools may vary.
